sections.heading: Squirrel Hill Bakeries and Specialty Food Spots

paragraphs.text: A local neighborhood guide highlights several specialty food and bakery stops throughout Squirrel Hill. Pigeon Bagels is noted as a former pop-up that became a permanent neighborhood fixture for bagels. Prantl’s Bakery operates a Squirrel Hill location recognized for its burnt almond torte, while Gaby et Jules is featured as a French pastry shop focusing on macarons. Allegro Hearth Bakery is noted for its bread selection, and Five Points Artisan Bakeshop operates at the edge of the neighborhood offering breads and an array of baked goods.

sections.heading: Squirrel Hill International and Casual Dining Options

For pizza, Squirrel Hill institutions Aiello’s and Mineo’s are listed among local Pittsburgh favorites.
